summary: PowerBank Corporation, a Toronto-based renewable energy developer listed on NASDAQ and Cboe Canada under PBK, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report on Form 8-K) disclosing termination of its at-the-market equity offering program established in February 2026. No price per share, program size, remaining capacity, fees, or advisor were disclosed, and the company gave no stated rationale. The ATM removal eliminates incremental equity supply overhang but also removes a flexible financing channel; watch liquidity, project funding needs, and any replacement facility or capital raise.
